name: Belgium
summary: Central Western European nation with the Scheldt and Meuse transit corridors. Heavily industrialized Flanders plain and dense highway networks influence ambient air particulate concentrations.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 2.12x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); dense industrial and transport density across Flanders and Antwerp port corridors.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; KMI Uccle recorded top-three warmest year in national history.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear least-squares warming trend across Belgian lowland stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.2% share of global emissions; Antwerp chemical hub and steel manufacturing drive emissions.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Reflects heavy chemical refining and transport crossroad hub position in Northwest Europe.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Ardennes upland forest reserves ~6,900 km² under sustainable silvicultural management.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: North Sea offshore and onshore wind (17.1%) and solar PV (10.2%) supplementing nuclear baseload.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 386 people/km²; urban population fraction is 98.1%.
